structured.answer: I'd probably go for Harel's "עוקב מדד S&P 500": the fee is 0.56% and the screen shows 13.7% for 3 years and 11.92% for 5. But all of that sits under "קופת גמל להשקעה", which to me sounds like a pension thing, so I wouldn't move the 30,000 today. I'm not sure that's even the right kind of product for me.

stuck.where: Product tabs under 'כל המוצרים של הראל'
stuck.why: The tab already picked was 'קופת גמל להשקעה 16', which I thought was a pension thing for older people. I didn't know if that's where I'd put savings or if I needed a different tab. There are 6 tabs and none of them says 'invest your savings'.

stuck.where: Return column, rows 'עוקב מדד S&P 500' and 'מניות'
stuck.why: I read '13.7% 3 שנים' as 13.7% over three years in total. I didn't notice the header saying 'תשואה שנתית ממוצעת' until later. 'מניות' at 24.04% looked better than S&P, and I nearly picked it just because the number was bigger.

stuck.where: Rows showing 'פחות מ־3 שנים' / 'פחות מ־5 שנים'
stuck.why: Most rows have no return number at all, just 'less than 3 years'. I couldn't compare them, so I skipped them.

stuck.where: Folds 'קרנות מחקות 5 קרנות' and 'קרנות סל 4 קרנות'
stuck.why: Funds that track an index are closer to what my friends talk about, but they're shut in folds lower down. I wasn't sure whether to open them, and I didn't.

used: Row 'עוקב מדד S&P 500': 0.56% מההיסכון, 0% מההפקדה, 13.7% 3 שנים, 11.92% 5 שנים
Line '16 מסלולים · דמי ניהול מההיסכון: מ־0.54% עד 0.61%'

The circle charts with מניות/מט"ח percentages
skipped: Top intro paragraph and '123 ממקור / מחושב / הזנה'
Small text under table: 'התקרה בחוק...', 'בנוסף לדמי הניהול יורדות...'
Folds: קרנות מחקות, מרכזית לפיצויים, קרנות סל

unsure_meaning: Whether 13.7% means per year or in total

Yellow vs green in the circles (I guessed green = shares, yellow = foreign currency)
not_found: What the fee comes to in shekels on 30,000 ₪
A clear 'start here' or recommended option
Whether I can add a few hundred shekels a month
What the first step is (how to join, a button)
Something saying whether this is right for someone young who might need the money

findings.what: The page opens on a product whose name sounds like a pension for old people. Nothing tells me it's a place to grow savings.
findings.where: Tab 'קופת גמל להשקעה' selected by default

findings.what: The fee is only shown as a percent, never in shekels, so 0.56% feels like nothing
Most tracks have no return figure, just 'פחות מ־3 שנים', so I couldn't compare most of the list
The return numbers don't say on the line itself that they're per year. I read them as totals.
16 tracks that look almost the same, with no recommendation. It makes me want to do nothing.
The index funds I actually came for are hidden in closed folds lower down
No button or next step for actually putting money in
